sourceSteps: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲左膝，用左手向后抓住左脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将左脚拉向臀肌，感受左股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
sourceImageLicense: Original Zeno artwork; no upstream exercise media used.
reviewObservation: Selected second image is clearly prone: teal back faces upward, abdomen/pelvis/thigh support is on the floor, same-side hand holds the bent-leg ankle, other leg is straight, other forearm supports the head. One side is illustrated; canonical source also instructs repeating the opposite side.
